display_name: Awareness E6: Texts and QR codes (full episode)
description: A thirteen-minute awareness episode for staff with a work phone. On an authorised exercise at Tarrowby Logistics, a fictional haulier, you first play the attacker: research the depot, then send one lookalike parking message. Then you swap seats and go through a work phone a message like it lands on. Only the phone is scored, and reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
